name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Car Vent Clip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 1-layer acrylic with a 3mm thickness, this custom car vent clip offers a sleek, modern look with a lightweight yet sturdy feel.
    - The acrylic piece features 1-sided printing, allowing your personalized design to stand out clearly on the front.
    - Comes with a durable car vent clip, adhesive dots, and a cotton fragrance pad for added functionality.
    - The combination of decorative acrylic and vent clip hardware creates a stylish accessory that is both practical and eye-catching.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Acrylic piece sizes available:
                  +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
                  +) 2.5 x 2.5 in ~ 6.35 x 6.35 cm
                  +) 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
    - Car vent clip overall height: 7.2 cm ~ 2.83 in
    - Top round of car vent clip diameter: 2.4 cm ~ 0.94 in
    - Bottom clip section height: 4 cm ~ 1.57 in
    - Clip width: 1 cm ~ 0.39 in
    - Cotton fragrance pad: 1.5 x 0.5 cm ~ 0.59 x 0.2 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions of the acrylic piece may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports single-sided printing on the acrylic piece.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a car vent clip that easily attaches to most vehicle air vents.
    - Includes a cotton fragrance pad, allowing you to add your favorite essential oil or fragrance to help freshen your car interior.
    - The personalized wooden topper adds decorative charm while the clip keeps it securely in place.
    - Compact and lightweight, making it perfect for daily use without blocking visibility or taking up extra space.
    - A great way to combine car decoration and light fragrance use in one personalized accessory.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful gift for family members, friends, couples, parents, coworkers, or car lovers.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, Christmas, graduations, or special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys personalized car accessories or custom keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful present that combines style, sentiment, and practical use.
    - Great for showcasing names, hobbies, professions, or themed artwork in a fun and memorable way.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Car Vent Clip

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
